wiki_to_rcqa.dataset: Dolma 3 Dolmino pool components wiki_to_rcqa-part1/2/3 (Wikipedia passages rephrased as reading-comprehension QA); part of the swarm's dolmino_synth_qa bucket
wiki_to_rcqa.selection_key: sha256(UTF8(str(seed) + colon + full gs URI)) ascending over all three parts; the first 1400 files form the pool in four consecutive groups of 350 (one packed part each, about 1.6x the per-part quota at 0.86 tokens per compressed byte), the next 32 form the held-out evaluation stream. Files whose zstd frame is not terminated (a truncated upload) are excluded and listed under 'excluded'; each is replaced at its own position by the next intact file in the ranking after the held-out block (ranks 1433, 1434), so the other 1398 pool files and the held-out stream are unchanged. Integrity was checked on 2026-09-19 by streaming every pinned file through the sweep's zstd reader.
